description: Validate a funding request and return the draw() calldata for the agent to submit on-chain. This creates the controlled spending pool. REQUIRES EIP-712 authentication: include agentAddress, nonce, expiry, and signature in arguments.

jobId.description: Job ID as a decimal string

nonce.description: Monotonically increasing nonce (use obligationNonces from financing contract)

requestedAmount.description: Requested USDC amount in raw units (6 decimals)

signature.description: EIP-712 signature: sign {agentAddress, nonce, expiry, chainId} over AverisProtocol v2 domain

name: averis_request_funding
title: Request Funding (Authenticated)
